hints: A range sum changes by a point update, so maintain a segment tree of sums.
For every node interval, store both its total sum and the best prefix sum inside it.
When joining left and right intervals, best prefix is max(left.best, left.sum+right.best).
analogy: The best prefix either stops inside the left half or takes all of it and continues into the right.
example: For segment [-2,3], total is 1 and best prefix is 1; either take -2+3 or just the first? max(-2,1)=1.
correctness: Any prefix of a concatenated interval either ends in A or includes all A and a prefix of B; the merge checks exactly those cases.
complexity: O(n) build, O(log n) per operation, O(n) space.
algorithm: Build a segment tree with each node storing segment sum and best prefix sum. Merge left A and right B as sum=A.sum+B.sum, prefix=max(A.prefix,A.sum+B.prefix). For type 1 point assignment, rebuild ancestors; for type 2 range query, merge covered nodes in left-to-right order and output best prefix.
